messages:
Maya S: Morning—quick async. What I did: demo with PulseHealth, shared perf dashboard.
Maya S: Blockers: legal asked for HSM attestation doc + network diagram for private deployment. Today: triage docs + ping infra for KMS/HSM details.
Ravi P: Nice work. I answered DPA Qs earlier. For HSM attestation we have an internal template, will upload. @Jules can you confirm whether we can share certs with a prospect? :thinking_face:
Jules (sales_ops): You can share a redacted attestation; full certs require NDA. Uploading template now. Also we should schedule a short demo with infra.
security-bot: New doc uploaded: /handbook/compliance/hsm-attestation-v2.pdf
Sam T (eng-infra): I can join the demo. Quick note: on-prem requires customer to expose a KMS endpoint or run our KM agent; we support key-wrap/envelope encryption. Blocker: need to know if they're AWS KMS or a Thales-style HSM appliance.
Priya (solutions): Prospect is AWS + Thales HSM appliance. They want BYOK and to know if Redwood can do key-wrap with their HSM. Also asked for SOC2 and encryption-at-rest language.
Ravi P: SOC2 link: https://redwood.app/compliance/soc2-summary.pdf. For BYOK we support envelope encryption; infra to confirm HSM cert sharing constraints.
Sam T (eng-infra): Confirmed BYOK/envelope supported. For Thales we need a PKCS#11 connector; validation ETA ~2 weeks unless they provide test certs sooner.
Maya S: I'll update the prospect timeline. Can someone do a quick PR review? small change in dedicated-customer-config: https://git.redwood/repo/dedicated-config/pull/457 — it enables a keywrap param.
Diego (eng-sre): I'll take the PR after standup. Note: the change touches bootstrap; add a feature flag and rollout plan.
Jules (sales_ops): Legal also asked if we have standard contractual language for encryption-at-rest for Dedicated. @Lena can you weigh in?
Lena (legal): We have a standard clause, will attach it here. FYI enterprise deals sometimes request HSM key escrow terms; that's negotiable but needs exec/legal sign-off.
Maya S: Thanks. Today's actions: (1) Maya to propose demo times, (2) Sam to validate PKCS#11 path & ETA, (3) Diego to review PR and prepare rollout notes, (4) Jules to share redacted attestation + legal clause. Please post updates here.
Jules (sales_ops): Shared redacted attestation + legal clause: https://files.redwood/attestations/pulsehealth-redacted.pdf :white_check_mark:
Ravi P: LOE for HSM validation updated to ~2 weeks. Tagging @account-exec-bot to update forecast.
account-exec-bot: Forecast updated for PulseHealth — moved to Contract Negotiation, Expected Close: 2026-07-15
Maya S: :tada: thanks team. If anything blocks, DM me directly.
